card.title: CORSAIR F4U-1C
card.flavorText: The Vought F4U Corsair was an American fighter aircraft used in World War II and later in the Korean War. The Corsair was both used as a carrier-based and land-based aircraft and served both the US Navy and the US Marines. Japanese pilots considered it a fearful aircraft in dogfights, and according to the US Navy it had a 11:1 kill ratio.
